patthana8.2:1.1: na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā. na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko ca na ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.2:2.1: na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.2:3.1: na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā : na sahetukañca na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko ca na ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.2:4.1: hetuyā nava ārammaṇe cha avigate nava.
patthana8.2:6.1: na sahetuko dhammo na sahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: na sahetuko dhammo na ahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: na sahetuko dhammo na sahetukassa ca na ahetukassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana8.2:7.1: na ahetuko dhammo na ahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: tīṇi.
patthana8.2:8.1: na sahetuko dhammo na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana8.2:9.1: hetuyā cha ārammaṇe nava avigate nava.
